query.statement: INSERT INTO TB_ANNOUNCEMENT (ANNOUNCEMENT_ID, NAME, STATUS_CD, CREATED_BY, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_BY, UPDATED_AT) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, SYSDATE, ?, SYSDATE)
SELECT ANNOUNCEMENT_ID, NAME, STATUS_CD, UPDATED_AT FROM TB_ANNOUNCEMENT WHERE NAME LIKE '%' || ? || '%' AND STATUS_CD = ? ORDER BY UPDATED_AT DESC
SELECT ANNOUNCEMENT_ID, NAME, STATUS_CD, CREATED_BY, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_BY, UPDATED_AT FROM TB_ANNOUNCEMENT WHERE ANNOUNCEMENT_ID = ?
UPDATE TB_ANNOUNCEMENT SET NAME = ?, STATUS_CD = ?, UPDATED_BY = ?, UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE ANNOUNCEMENT_ID = ?
